name: Homesty.ai
tagline: A buyer asks about a property and gets answers from the real listing.
description: Buyers ask listing agents the same five questions about every flat, and agents answer them by hand all day. I have been building Homesty since November 2025 to take that first conversation: the landing page, the chat, a REST API, admin pages, login and an audit log, on Next.js, Node, Postgres and Prisma.

name: Anvil
tagline: Webhooks that run once, even when the provider sends them twice.
description: Stripe and GitHub re-deliver webhooks, and a worker that crashes after doing the work gets the same event again, so you charge a card twice. Anvil verifies the signature over the raw body, dedupes in Redis on a hash of signature plus payload, and hands the job to a BullMQ worker with a fixed retry schedule and a dead-letter queue.

name: Anchor
tagline: Retrieval that says no source instead of guessing.
description: Most RAG demos improvise when nothing in the index matches, and in real estate an improvised answer is a legal problem. Anchor runs a cosine search on pgvector and returns a null answer when the best hit falls under a floor you set per index.

name: Tripwire
tagline: Stops an LLM response mid-stream the moment a rule matches.
description: Checking after the whole response is generated is too late; the user has already read it. Tripwire tests every streamed chunk and aborts the stream on a match. Ships as an OpenAI-compatible proxy.

name: Stackup
tagline: A production-shaped Kubernetes cluster on a laptop, in one command.
description: Canary rollouts, metrics and GitOps only make sense together. Stackup bootstraps a kind cluster, ArgoCD syncs the rest, Argo Rollouts canaries advance only while the success rate holds and roll back on their own.

name: Goldset
tagline: A GitHub Action that blocks a merge when an AI app's answers get worse.
description: Goldset scores the current output against a golden dataset with a judge model and posts the delta on the PR.

name: Quickdraw
tagline: Measures how an LLM streams on your network and your prompts.
description: Records time to first token, tokens per second, latency and cost for your prompts, in CI so the numbers become a trend.

name: Codecraft
tagline: An IDE in the browser that boots a real dev server inside the tab.
description: Binds Monaco and xterm to a WebContainers Node runtime, so a Vite project runs in the page and edits hot-reload in seconds.
